title: Hatsune Miku — Because You Burn So Bright〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come back any time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See you guys later!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Now then...
Miku, would you mind helping me put away the cups?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO.
I'd like a refill for my coffee.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I'd like another iced tea!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Didn't you just hear me say that I'm putting away the cups now? If you want a refill, come give me a hand with these.

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Luka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Quit acting like little kids, you two.
Len, let's go help her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! We can grab those jellies in the fridge while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good call!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some may take that as being childish...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? That's fine by me if they're willing to help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But we're your customers...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I hope Kohane and the others never see how slothful they can be.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I'm a little surprised.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Seeing them become a team, figure out their own style and improve so quickly has been fun to watch...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they've even begun embracing their identities as singers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. An, Akito and Toya more or less seemed to be doing that already...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I couldn't be happier about how much Kohane's been growing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I'm only going to like them even more in the future.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You do really enjoy it when they put their game faces on.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those fiery eyes that tell me they'll continue to pursue their dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND no matter what...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just seeing that expression gets me really excited.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're much more hands-off than me, MEIKO, but you also really like it when they're in that state, don't you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As the owner of this cafe, I'd like to be more directly involved like the rest of you instead of just watching over them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've been feeling that more and more recently.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, I started coming here more often because of them♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too. Making mixes on my own was fun, but I realized that things were more fun with them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is that why you two haven't been wandering around as much lately?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I see that as a good change since you two are much easier to get a hold of now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now if only you two would help out around here more.

rows.Speaker: Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Alright, fine.
I'll give you a hand.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just promise to give me a refill, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I promise.
